The Vessel

Ethel Jane

One exceptional vessel. Three ways to experience her. Ethel Jane is a classic 33-foot Regal 3360 Window Express based at the Washington Channel — intimate enough for two, spacious enough for eight, and impeccably maintained for every occasion, and dressed for the occasion every time she leaves the dock.

Sightseeing
Daytime Cruise
3 Hours Up to 8 Guests Daytime
The perfect introduction to the Potomac. Cruise past the monuments, Kennedy Center, and Georgetown waterfront under open skies. Ideal for families, first-timers, and out-of-town guests.

per charter
Most Popular
Monument Sunset
3 Hours Up to 8 Guests Evening
Glide past the Lincoln Memorial, Jefferson, and Washington Monument as they illuminate the Potomac at dusk. Champagne and charcuterie included. The classic Iron Tide experience.

Celebrations
Golden Hour
4 Hours Up to 8 Guests Late Afternoon
Late afternoon into dusk — the Potomac at its most beautiful. Prosecco, curated playlist, golden light on the monuments. The go-to for birthdays, bachelorettes, and celebrations that deserve more than three hours.

per charter

Dinner Cruise
4 Hours Up to 8 Guests Evening

per charter
Full Day
Potomac Escape
6 Hours Up to 8 Guests Day or Evening
Head south into quieter waters toward Alexandria or Mount Vernon, anchor for a swim, and enjoy a catered lunch on deck. Unhurried, entirely yours, and a world away from the capital.

per charter
Signature · Intimate
Chef's Table
4 Hours 2–6 Guests Evening
A private chef boards with you and crafts a multi-course dinner to your taste — local Chesapeake ingredients, fine wine pairings, and the Washington skyline at night. Unlike the Dinner Cruise, every detail here is bespoke: the menu, the pace, the presentation. DC's most intimate dining experience.
$2,200
per charter

On the Potomac

Curated Journeys

Signature Experiences

01
Sunset Soirée
Three hours of golden light on the Potomac, with the monuments glowing at dusk. Champagne service and curated canapés as Washington transforms behind you.
02
Island Odyssey
Venture down to the Chesapeake Bay for a full day — secluded coves, paddleboarding, crabbing, and a gourmet lunch served aboard or ashore.
03
Overnight Voyage
Anchor overnight in a quiet Chesapeake cove. Sleep on glassy water and wake to a chef-prepared breakfast as the bay comes alive around you.
04
Corporate & Private Events
The capital's most distinctive venue. Lobby dinners, fundraisers, press events, or intimate celebrations — on the water, steps from the Hill.

Your Captain

Captain Zakary Wenning

Owner & Operator · Iron Tide Charters

Captain Zak Wenning is a U.S. Coast Guard-licensed Master Captain (100 Ton) and CPR/AED certified professional with a lifelong passion for boating and hospitality. As captain of the Ethel Jane — a beautifully maintained 33-foot Regal 3360 Window Express — he specializes in creating memorable private experiences on the Potomac.

Zak's love for the water began at age 11, operating boats and jet skis on the lakes of Michigan. What started as a childhood passion evolved into a professional calling. Today he brings more than a decade of boating experience and nearly 10 years navigating the Potomac — from the Georgetown Waterfront and The Wharf to National Harbor and Old Town Alexandria.

Beyond his maritime credentials, Zak has spent more than two decades as an award-winning video producer and editor for National Geographic and CuriosityStream. His background in storytelling and attention to detail shapes every charter — thoughtful touches and personalized service designed to create lasting memories.

"The best moments happen on the water. I look forward to welcoming you aboard the Ethel Jane."

— Captain Zak Wenning
